trap-nonspeakable.notes: MATH FINDING to report (not edited): 'The composition vanishes if and only if q = 1 or [xi, alpha] = 0' is stated as an iff but only the 'if' direction follows. The prefactor q^{-1}(1 - q^{-1}) vanishes exactly at q = 1 (correct, since q^{-1} is a unit), but the product omega_V wedge_q [xi, alpha] can also vanish when omega_V = 0 or when [xi, alpha] lies in the kernel of omega_V wedge_q (-). Given the omega_V = d(pi_V(d 1_A)) = 0 problem flagged on prf:categorical-dq-squared, the omega_V branch is not hypothetical. Suggest 'vanishes if q = 1 or [xi, alpha] = 0' plus a genericity hypothesis on omega_V - which the next sentence already assumes when it says 'For generic alpha'.
